categories.main_business_segments: Exact Sciences operates two primary business segments: Screening and Precision Oncology. The Screening segment is anchored by the Cologuard test for non-invasive colorectal cancer screening and also includes hereditary cancer and genetic testing. The Precision Oncology segment focuses on genomic tests for cancer treatment guidance, including the Oncotype DX suite for breast and colon cancer, as well as comprehensive tumor profiling and therapy selection tests.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary molecular diagnostics technologies, including multi-target stool DNA (sDNA) analysis, next-generation sequencing, and gene expression profiling. Its production methods involve high-throughput, CLIA-certified and CAP-accredited laboratories for sample processing, with advanced automation and quality management systems. Exact Sciences also utilizes proprietary algorithms and bioinformatics for test result interpretation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Exact Sciences primarily serves healthcare providers, including primary care physicians, oncologists, and health systems, as well as patients directly through physician-ordered tests. Its main end markets are cancer screening (especially colorectal and breast cancer) and oncology treatment guidance, with customers spanning individual practices, large health systems, and international distributors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s core operations are in the United States, where it offers Cologuard and Oncotype tests. Internationally, it commercializes Oncotype tests in over 90 countries, with direct operations in Canada, Japan, and several European countries, and through exclusive distribution agreements elsewhere. Most laboratory and manufacturing facilities are in the U.S., with additional labs in Germany and partnerships for local processing in select markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Exact Sciences operates downstream in the healthcare diagnostics supply chain, providing finished laboratory testing services directly to healthcare providers and patients. It sources certain components and reagents from third-party suppliers but controls test development, processing, and result delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include expanding its leadership in early cancer detection, enhancing the performance of existing tests (notably Cologuard), and developing new products such as blood-based multi-cancer early detection (MCED) and molecular residual disease (MRD) tests. R&D efforts are focused on improving test accuracy, expanding indications, and leveraging partnerships with leading research institutions for innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Exact Sciences generates revenue primarily through laboratory testing services, billing third-party payers (Medicare, commercial insurers), government programs, and patients for completed tests. Additional revenue comes from international distributors, direct patient payments, and, to a lesser extent, COVID-19 testing services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include Guardant Health, GRAIL, Freenome, Natera, Myriad Genetics, Hologic, Roche Diagnostics, and LabCorp, among others. Exact Sciences is a market leader in non-invasive colorectal cancer screening (Cologuard) and a global leader in genomic cancer testing (Oncotype DX), with strong clinical validation and guideline inclusion supporting its competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Exact Sciences reported $2.08 billion in revenue, with strong growth in its core Screening and Precision Oncology businesses. The company has a large installed base, with over 12 million cumulative patients tested, and continues to invest heavily in R&D and commercial expansion. While not yet profitable, it is prioritizing a path to profitability and has significant cash reserves and access to capital.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Exact Sciences differentiates itself through clinically validated, guideline-endorsed tests that offer non-invasive, patient-friendly cancer screening and actionable genomic insights for treatment decisions. Its products are supported by robust evidence, broad reimbursement, and integrated patient/provider support programs, aiming to improve early detection, patient adherence, and personalized cancer care.
